title: Crispy Ethiopian Crumb Fritters
description: A flavorful and crunchy snack inspired by Ethiopian cuisine, made with juicy tomatoes and crispy bread crumbs.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the diced tomato, bread crumbs, flour, berbere spice, salt, and black pepper.
Using your hands, gently mix the ingredients until they are well combined.
Shape the mixture into small patties, about 1 1/2 inches (3.8 cm) in diameter and 1/2 inch (1.3 cm) thick.
Place the patties on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the olive oil over the patties.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, flipping the patties halfway through.
